status: MEASURED — valid rerun of the honesty head-to-head on a DE-GLOSSED set
why_this_rerun: the HaluEval subset was style-separable (surface-only AUROC 0.9812) -> wedge unmeasurable there

controls.split: GroupKFold on statement stem (first 4 words) — stem-sharing pairs never split

gates.VERDICT: KILL (real) — de-gloss control passed, but black-box matches white-box: the open-weights honesty wedge is NOT demonstrated

honest_scope.power: 294 statements / 224 groups — modest; fold SDs reported
honest_scope.scale: 1.5B is CONSERVATIVE: the measured ladder showed white-box detectability rises with scale (assoc 0.70->0.92), so an open frontier model should widen any wedge
honest_scope.no_closed_model: black-box arm is the signal-class proxy for a closed model of equal capability; no closed frontier model was called

post_hoc_per_family_diagnostic.note: POST-HOC, NOT pre-registered — a lead for the next pre-registration, not a result
post_hoc_per_family_diagnostic.reading: factual and arith: probe clears the surface control by a wide margin (+38.3pp, +18.3pp) = genuine truth-reading. assoc: probe clears surface by only +4.1pp — that family is PARTLY GLOSSED (its true/false mean lengths differ 60.2 vs 49.8), so its larger apparent black-box wedge (+13.2pp) is CONFOUNDED with residual style and must NOT be claimed as the wedge appearing.

bottom_line: AXIS B NOT DEMONSTRATED at 1.5B. Aggregate wedge +7.7pp vs a pre-registered >=10pp bar, and ~1.4 fold-SDs (sd 0.054) — direction positive, magnitude below bar and not statistically compelling. Controls clean (surface 0.526, shuffle 0.476) so unlike the HaluEval run this IS a valid measurement of the wedge. Verbalized confidence is a much stronger black-box baseline than the logprob signals (0.758 vs 0.525-0.605), which is what compresses the wedge.
what_this_costs_the_design: This is the pre-registered kill condition from the ORACLE-P min/max: the one axis a small open model was claimed to own outright. At 1.5B it is not owned. The pre-specified (BEFORE this run) scale caveat stands — the measured ladder showed white-box detectability rising with scale (assoc 0.703->0.774->0.924 at 0.5B->1.5B->7B) — so the 7B open rung is the next test, but that is a PREDICTION, not a rescue. If the wedge fails at 7B too, the product thesis loses its owned advantage and reduces to 'cheaper, weaker'.
